title: Skills from skills.sh
summary: Search the skills.sh directory from the app and install a skill in one click, for yourself or, on the site, for a whole organization.
usage: Open Settings › Skills (or Ctrl+K), type what you need and press Search, then Install on a result. When you click Save settings, the skill is downloaded and installed like any other: turn it off or remove it whenever you want. On the site, owners and maintainers can do the same in the organization's Skills tab to install it for every member. Read a skill's instructions before installing it.
